verses.2: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.4: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
verses.6: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.7: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.8: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O
verses.15: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
